technology_boundary: The following parent and input declarations define the selected premise technologies and their ordinary ecoinvent suppliers. Copy only declared technology processes. Preserve native quantities, production, units, signs and exchange metadata.
location_resolution_rule: Use the exact supplier declared for the actual native parent and input.
leakage_rule: Early frontier technosphere inputs use project technology copies or declared ordinary ecoinvent suppliers. Premise 2020 and 2025 supply the declared technologies; their ordinary inputs use the declared ecoinvent suppliers.
post_2030_rule: From 2030 onward, ordinary and technology inputs use the same selected-member premise anchor.
limitation: regional material location remains distinct from provider geography. The declared RER, country, RoW and global suppliers provide the selected processes.
